# GitHub Chart Builder

> Generate customizable SVG contribution charts for README / portfolio.
> Canonical: https://gh.ruu.by/ — Spec: /openapi.json — About: /about

## Quick embed

```md
![contributions](https://gh.ruu.by/api/github-contributions/YOUR_USERNAME?months=12)
```

- Default user chart: `GET /api/github-contributions/{username}?months=12`
- Repo-filtered: `?repo=owner/repo` or `?repo=repo1,owner/repo2` (comma-separated, `owner/repo` or bare name)
- Date range: `?months=12` (1-48) OR `?from=2024-01-01&to=2024-12-31` OR `?from=2024-01-01` (runs to today)
- Style: `?boxSize=12&boxSpacing=3&borderRadius=3&backgroundColor=transparent&inactiveColor=%23ebedf0&minActivityColor=%239be9a8&maxActivityColor=%23216e39&showLabels=true&showYears=false&labelColor=%2324292f&ignoreOutliers=false`
- Output: `image/svg+xml` with `<title>` tooltips per day. Cache: 10 min server, 1h CDN header.

## API

- `GET /api/github-contributions/:username` → SVG. Params: months, from, to, repo, boxSize, boxSpacing, borderRadius, backgroundColor, inactiveColor, minActivityColor, maxActivityColor, showLabels, showYears, labelColor, ignoreOutliers, token.
- `GET /api/github-repos/:username` → `["owner/repo", ...]` JSON. Optional `?token=` or `Authorization: Bearer <encrypted>`.
- `GET /api/auth/github` → 302 GitHub OAuth (`repo,read:user`). Callback returns `/?token=<aes-256-gcm>&username=`.
- `GET /api/themes` → community themes JSON `[{id,name,author,inactiveColor,minActivityColor,maxActivityColor,likes,createdAt}]`.
- `POST /api/themes` → submit `{name,author?,inactiveColor,minActivityColor,maxActivityColor,clientId}`. Limits: 3/hour + 10 total per salted browser id. Page: /themes.
- `POST /api/themes/:id/like` → `{clientId}`, one like per salted browser id.
- Auth rule for agents: `token=` is ALWAYS the encrypted payload from OAuth callback. Never send a raw GitHub PAT, never log or publish a URL containing `?token=`.

- github: #ebedf0 / #9be9a8 / #216e39
- sunset: #ffe5e5 / #ff9a76 / #d62828
- ocean: #e0f2fe / #7dd3fc / #0369a1

- tokyo night: #16161e / #7aa2f7 / #bb9af3

## Notes

- CORS `*` on GET — safe to fetch/embed anywhere.
- Private repos require user OAuth; public charts need no token.
- Full machine spec: https://gh.ruu.by/openapi.json
- Step-by-step agent guide: https://gh.ruu.by/agents.md
